description: This is a Kotlin source file defining the HomeFragment class for an Android TV app. It manages the home screen UI with multiple rows displaying workouts, progress, badges, and profile info, integrating various UI components, data sources, and navigation.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment representing the home screen of the app, displaying various workout and profile-related rows with interactive elements.

classes.name: StringPresenter
classes.description: Inner class presenter for binding simple string items as clickable cards for profile and setup options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up UI, builds content rows, and event listeners.

methods.name: setupUi
methods.description: Configures the fragment's UI elements such as title, colors, headers, and search affordance.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Constructs each row of the home screen including workouts, progress, badges, and profile options.

methods.name: setupEventListeners
methods.description: Sets navigation and item click event handlers for the implemented UI.

methods.name: openOnboarding
methods.description: Starts the onboarding activity for app setup.
